description: This PHP source file defines the class LoggerFormattingInfo, which encapsulates information obtained from parsing formatting modifiers related to logging output formatting. It includes properties for minimum and maximum width, and left alignment, along with methods for resetting and dumping this information.

classes.name: LoggerFormattingInfo
classes.description: Encapsulates the formatting modifiers information for logging output, including min/max width and alignment.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets formatting properties to their default values.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Logs the current state of formatting information using LoggerLog::debug.
